race.description: Happy 66th Birthday Mick Meehan Mdn Plate (C1)
race.comment: AKIRA SAN (7) is the top contender after finishing a close second at the Sunshine Coast over 1800m as the odds-on favourite, following a dominant Mdn win on heavy ground by nearly nine lengths. The first attempt at 1910m shouldn't pose a problem, and her consistent form and wet-track prowess, along with Gary Geran, give her the edge. LATIN LIGHTS (8) poses the main threat after a neck second in a FM BM58 at Coffs Harbour, gaining 3kg weight relief with Andrew Mallyon. In career-best form and Andrew Mallyon retains the ride. CRUNCH TIME (1) returns quickly and drops in trip and weight after he finished a close-up fifth at the Sunshine Coast over 2200m. Deep into the prep and has a host of gear changes. RIGHTEOUS LEGEND (5) was wide throughout at Ipswich, so that run has an excuse. Fitter third-up and can contest.
